stories.title: Verification domain model and result persistence
Wallet detail and dashboard verification surfaces

completedFeatures.notes: Added SQLite support with database abstraction layer, migrated all PostgreSQL stored procedures to Python query classes
Added Orange Plot, Balance Chart, Custody Chart visualizations, btc_viz CLI, and PDF report generation
Dead code removal, wallet_imports.py extraction, performance fixes
CLI import system with registry, validation, 8 exchange parsers (Coinbase, Kraken, Strike, River, Swan, Cash App, Gemini, Native), --dry-run and --withdraw-to support
Wallet import parsers (Ledger Live, Trezor Suite, Sparrow, Coldcard) integrated into CLI import system with --wallet-name support
Added FIAT_CURRENCIES constant and is_fiat() helper, updated all exchange parsers (Kraken, Swan, River, Gemini, Coinbase Pro) to handle fiat deposits/withdrawals
Modernized export_tx with argparse, added wallet/date filtering, --wallets for multiple wallets, dry-run preview, Spend transaction type support, PostgreSQL compatibility

Refactored cryptoAccounts.py from 918-line monolithic class into 4 specialized query classes (TransactionQuery, LedgerWriter, CapitalGainCalculator, WalletQuery) using Query Object pattern with dependency injection. 54% reduction in main class size, 1,264 lines of new tests, zero regressions.

Full-featured terminal UI with Textual: dashboard, portfolio, ledger with summary stats, trade history, record transaction, import wizard with file browser, export, tax reporting (gains/1099-B/forecast), visualizations, and help system. Keyboard and mouse driven.
Smart wallet inputs with autocomplete and validation, whitespace normalization at storage layer, TUI duplicate detection in Import Wizard, CLI input guarding in recording scripts

Dedicated TUI screen for wallet CRUD operations: create, edit, rename, merge, toggle active. WalletQuery extensions with atomic rename/merge. Transaction count warnings for destructive operations. Dashboard wallet card with clickable link.
Added TUI transaction detail, edit, soft-delete, restore, and show-deleted flows backed by ledger soft-delete columns and new LedgerWriter update/delete/restore methods.

completedFeatures.featureName: Bitcoin Accounting Rebrand and Compatibility Migration
completedFeatures.notes: Completed staged rebrand from crypto* to bitcoin* with compatibility shims, canonical entrypoints, path/cache migration fallback, and documentation migration guidance.
Removed all legacy crypto* shims and aliases post-deprecation window. Finalized canonical bitcoin* naming across modules, CLI entrypoints, data paths, docs, scripts, and tests.

Four-module integrity suite (reconciliation, transfer-pair, basis-continuity, health-score) with weighted 0-100 score, configurable tiers, snapshot persistence, and bitcoin-integrity CLI. PostgreSQL and SQLite compatible. 5,678 lines across 19 files; 1,200+ tests.

Month-end attestation bundle generation (JSON/CSV) with deterministic run IDs, optional PDF reports via reportlab with graceful degradation, TUI monitoring dashboard with TreasuryIntegrityPanel and AttestationScreen (findings drill-down, source/severity filters, inline export), rule-based AlertEngine with AlertRule, finding lifecycle tracker (FindingTracker: new→acknowledged→resolved) persisted in SQLite. 148 tests across 4 test files.

completedFeatures.featureName: Web Foundation, API Layer, Auth, and Deployment
completedFeatures.notes: Established the FastAPI web foundation with canonical JSON models, signed-cookie auth, request-scoped database dependencies, readiness/liveness endpoints, deployment bootstrap, and subpath-aware runtime configuration.

Delivered web gains tracking, 1099-B export, sale forecasting, 2025+ wallet-separation policy enforcement, and lightweight preset/history support while preserving parity with the core Python tax logic.

completedFeatures.featureName: Web Portfolio Dashboard and Wallet Views
completedFeatures.notes: Mobile-first portfolio dashboard with total BTC balance, cost basis, custody breakdown, wallet balances with inactive toggle, recent transactions strip, and wallet detail view with deep-link support. Server-injected <base href> for subpath-safe routing. Clickable wallet list drills into per-wallet detail with filtered transactions. 14 API tests + Playwright smoke coverage for click-through and direct URL deep-links. Removed redundant quick-action buttons in favor of navbar navigation.

completedFeatures.featureName: Web Ledger, Transaction Entry, and Wallet Management
completedFeatures.notes: Ledger explorer with pagination/filters/summary, transaction detail/edit/delete/restore, manual transaction entry (buy/sell/transfer/interest), wallet CRUD with rename/merge/sync, audit logging, ledger wallet dropdown. 55 tests.

completedFeatures.featureName: Web Import Center and Duplicate Review
completedFeatures.notes: Authenticated web import center with upload, parser detection, preview, duplicate review, commit flow, and import history/troubleshooting aids. Browser flow stays aligned with the existing Python import pipeline.

completedFeatures.featureName: Web Block Clock and Bitcoin Node Presence
completedFeatures.notes: Optional bitcoind-backed chain status service and dashboard card showing height, sync posture, peer count, mempool summary, freshness, and degraded-state messaging. Includes API coverage and deployment docs for local-node environments.

Read-only web trades page with paginated trade history, per-trade cost basis, liquidity-by-exchange summary, and cost-basis overview cards. Includes authenticated API routes, responsive SPA views, exchange filtering, and pytest/Playwright coverage.
